pr_body:
Closes gh-32028

### Motivation
- On #32028 , we found that `DefaultRestClientBuilder.defaultRequest(...)` doesn't do anything
  - Cause `RestClientBuilder.build()` doesn't pass `defaultRequest` to `RestClient`

### Modification
- Fix `RestClient` to use defaultRequest on `RestClient.Builder`

### Result
- Now `RestClient` uses `defaultRequest` that passed from `RestClientBuilder.build()` well

issue_context.title: `DefaultRestClientBuilder.defaultRequest(...)` doesn't do anything
issue_context.body:
`DefaultRestClientBuilder.defaultClient(Consumer<RestClient.RequestHeadersSpec<?>>)` can be used to set a property, but that property is never actually used when building the `RestClient`.

Is this related to #31625?
